definitions.explanation: An educational system where male and female students study together in the same institution. Short for {男女|だんじょ}{共学|きょうがく}.

examples.japanese: この{学校|がっこう}は{共学|きょうがく}です。
{来年|らいねん}から{共学|きょうがく}になる{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: It is scheduled to become coeducational starting next year.

examples.japanese: {戦後|せんご}、{多|おお}くの{学校|がっこう}が{男女|だんじょ}{共学|きょうがく}に{切|き}り{替|か}わった。
examples.english: After the war, many schools switched to coeducation.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the full form {男女|だんじょ}{共学|きょうがく}. The shortened form {共学|きょうがく} is common in casual speech. Used as a noun that can also modify other nouns (e.g., {共学|きょうがく}の{学校|がっこう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男女|だんじょ}{共学|きょうがく} (coeducation)
- {共学|きょうがく}の{大学|だいがく} (coeducational university)
- {共学|きょうがく}になる (to become coeducational)
- {共学|きょうがく}{化|か} (becoming coeducational)

RELATED WORDS:
- {男子校|だんしこう}: boys' school
- {女子校|じょしこう}: girls' school
- {別学|べつがく}: separate-gender education
